verdict.rationale: The API supports the core pipeline (create applicant, create workflow run, poll or webhook for results, OAuth client-credentials scoped tokens) which an agent could drive programmatically, but there is no evidence of an MCP server/surface, no explicit 're-check' trigger endpoint, and no mention of scoped credentials designed for agent/AI use. missing for 10: MCP server or agent-native surface, explicit re-check/retry API documentation, fine-grained scoped credentials for autonomous agents, independent confirmation of agent-driven usage.
